attchmntText: Bluspring Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about Submission of Newspaper Publication on the Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bluspring Enterprises Limited published its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in the Financial Express and Hosa Digantha on November 07, 2026. BF Utilities Limited reported a net loss of 251.67 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. BCPL Railway Infrastructure Limited reported a net profit of 292.45 million on a standalone basis for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Kamdhenu Ventures Limited issued a notice for postal ballot seeking shareholder approval for the appointment of Smt. Saroj Pundhir as a Non-Executive Independent Director for five years from October 1, 2026, to October 29, 2031. Voting is open from November 7, 2026, to December 6, 2026, with results to be announced by December 8, 2026. Bluspring Enterprises Limited reported consolidated net profit of 127.25 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Bluspring Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about Audio Recording of the Investor/Analysts  Earnings Conference Call on the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bluspring Enterprises Limited has uploaded the audio recording of the Investor and Analysts Earnings Conference Call regarding the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call was held on November 07, 2026, at 10:30 A.M. IST. The recording is available on the Company’s website at the specified link. This filing is made pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The announcement serves for information and records of BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited.
